The Bears, led by second-year head coach [[Steve Smiley]], played their home games at [[Bank of Colorado Arena]] in [[Greeley, Colorado]] as members of the [[Big Sky Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2020–21 Northern Colorado Bears men's basketball team|Bears]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 11–11, 6–8 in Big Sky play to finish in a tie for seventh place. As the #8 seed in the [[2021 Big Sky Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Sky tournament]], they defeated #9 seed [[2020–21 Sacramento State Hornets men's basketball team|Sacramento State]] in the first round,{{cite web|url=https://bigskyconf.com/news/2021/3/10/mens-basketball-northern-colorado-wins-tight-contest-over-sacramento-state-advance-to-play-southern-utah.aspx|title=Northern Colorado Wins Tight Contest Over Sacramento State, Advance to Play Southern Utah|work=Big Sky Conference|access-date=October 31, 2021|language=en}} before falling to top seeded [[2020–21 Southern Utah
